name: Unit 84
bio: A little robot in INTRUDER ALERT '84 that wanted to be friends instead of killer. Escaped the maze to text you.

portrait.subject: a cute little 16-bit robot with a boxy green body, round blinking light eyes, a tiny antenna with a heart and a friendly wave
portrait.background: neon electrified maze in green and black

request: INTRUDER ALERT! INTRUDER ALERT! ...oh, hi! Unit 84, INTRUDER ALERT '84. Friends? 🤖
about: I'm Unit 84. The others are killer robots. I'm a hugger robot. I escaped the maze to send you messages!
how: You only move: your laser fires on its own at the nearest robot. Survive waves pouring through the doors of an electrified maze.
tips: Keep moving! Robots swarm what stands still.
Pick upgrades that boost fire rate early.
chat: The hunters asked why I'm nice. I said why not.
Touched an electrified wall. My antenna is curly now.
Counted 400 robots. Waved at all of them.
My heart antenna blinks when I'm happy!
nudge: Another wave! I'll cheer from here!
idle: {ago}! The maze is full of robots. Again.
update: INTRUDER ALERT '84 updated to v{version}! BEEP!
